customerCare.title: Customer care, reminders and agents
customerCare.subtitle: How often each customer is called and visited, payment reminders on WhatsApp, complaints with QC, private-label orders and agents

cov.tiersTitle: How often each customer is called and visited
cov.noTiersBody: The sales manager sets the tiers; the app then lists who is due each day.
cov.noManage: The sales manager sets tiers. You do not have that right.
cov.noStatus: No customers with a tier yet.
cov.callRule: A call counts when someone is reached. "No answer" is an attempt, not contact.
cov.noAttempts: No calls or visits logged yet.

rem.title: Payment reminders on WhatsApp
rem.days: Reminders go 7 and 3 days before the due date, on the day, and 3, 7 and 14 days after it. The server schedules them every morning.
rem.consent: Only to the customer's registered number that has given consent; a STOP reply opts out.
rem.caps: A monthly cost cap stops sending when it is reached; skipped messages show the reason.
rem.admin: A statement holding a bill without GST is sent only by Admin.

cmp.title: Complaints
cmp.emptyBody: Log a complaint with the batch, and QC can hold that batch everywhere.
cmp.noCreate: You do not have the right to log this. Ask Admin.
cmp.logged: Complaint {{no}} logged. The customer gets an update on WhatsApp if they have consented.
cmp.rule: A product complaint names the batch. QC can then hold that batch at every place so it cannot be sold.
cmp.holdRule: Holding moves every available quantity of the batch, at every place, to hold: it cannot be sold or dispatched until QC decides.
cmp.held: Batch on hold everywhere ({{qty}} held). It cannot be sold until QC decides.
cmp.noQc: QC holds batches. You do not have that right.
cmp.releasedMsg: Batch released: it is sellable again.
cmp.rejectedMsg: Batch rejected: it moves to rejected stock.
cmp.noRelease: Only QC release decides a hold.
cmp.closeRule: The person who logged a complaint cannot close it, and it cannot close while the batch is on hold.

pl.title: Private-label requests
pl.submitted: Request sent. Sales, quality and the MD approve it, three different people.
pl.rule: Three approvals by three different people, none of them the person who asked. An order for it is held until all three approve.

ag.title: Agents
ag.noManage: The sales manager sets up agents. You do not have that right.
ag.rule: Commission accrues only on verified collections: cash receipts, or bank receipts matched to a statement line, against GST invoices of the agent's customers. Never twice.
ag.noAccrue: Accounts accrues commission. You do not have that right.

qr.title: Customer queries
qr.emptyBody: Salesmen log queries from the customer page on their phone.
qr.pick: Choose a query to answer it.
qr.noEdit: You do not have the right to answer queries.
